title: E-GapLimiter
description: This datapack adds a customizable E-GapLimiter
body:
### Description

This mod adds a simple E-GapLimiter. When a player has too many egaps, they are dropped out of their inventory.

## Admin Commands
**/scoreboard players set $max_egaps max_egaps (Number)** - sets the maximum amount of e-gaps allowed in an inventory
